Create a 8-second vertical 9:16 video that looks like casual smartphone footage recorded by a fan at a large fictional outdoor music festival in Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, during a foggy summer weekend in 2025.

Moment: attendees arriving through a tree-lined entrance.
Camera position: walking behind a small group carrying jackets.
Time: early afternoon.
Scene details: cool fog between eucalyptus trees and orange wristbands.
During the clip: the group points toward distant stage lights.

Keep the same fictional event identity used across the collection: towering eucalyptus trees, cool San Francisco fog, a main stage with three vertical LED towers, purple/amber/teal lighting, and orange attendee wristbands. This is collection variation 1; use distinct fictional attendees and framing.

The footage must feel genuinely amateur: handheld camera shake, imperfect framing, people occasionally obstructing the lens, autofocus briefly hunting, exposure reacting to stage lights, mild motion blur, digital phone compression, and slightly blown highlights. It should feel like an ordinary memory, not a commercial, drone shot, professional concert film, or stabilized cinematic production.

All people are fictional adults. A performer may appear only as a small distant unidentifiable silhouette. Use original ambient crowd noise and indistinct non-melodic stage sound only. No recognizable song, lyrics, real artist likeness, logos, branded signage, readable text, copyrighted characters, captions, or watermarks.
